decided: When pushing is turned on, orbit pushes to the change's own pull request branch on the remote the project's pull requests use, and decides whether anything is left to push by comparing against that branch, never against another branch the checkout happens to follow.
alternatives: decide by the branch the checkout follows, which can be a different remote and so skip a push the pull request needs
why: The pull request shows only what reaches its own branch. Orbit does not ask the remote afresh before comparing, so if the remote has lost commits, orbit notices only at the next commit; that is stated as a known limit.
